axes.proposal: Page files are the only Arabic text. Display = render(span): the page slice at the resolved span minus a closed, tested deletion list (footnote markers; paragraph breaks become one space). Sigla stay unless the span ends before them. A book's quotation of an ayah is shown as printed with a link to Ayah; differences flagged, never substituted. model:check asserts render(span)==slice minus markers for every span.

Two records. Statement = what a speaker said: span(s), speaker Mention or author-with-basis-span, chain, role (ADR 0011). Assertion = what the app shows: subject and object as Mention ids reached through Identification, closed predicate, value spans|object|parsed (machine-checked)|classified (reviewed, span shown beside), restsOn Statements. Catalog retired. Plain Siyar value ~6 records; heading identifications SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT, bulk-reviewed.

Chain = ordered (Link|Gap). Link: narrator Mention, mode spans (list), modeKey 1:1 with printed lemma+person/number; abbreviations (ثنا، أنا) map to full key, span kept; unmapped form fails. Gap anywhere with optional marker span (ta'liq, mursal, balagha); no edge crosses a Gap. Derived class jazm/tamrid. enclosedBy for quoted books. Anonymous speaker = unidentified unnamed-group Mention, rendered 'unnamed view reported by'. Edition.riwayah is a Chain.

One global Agent per person. Every entity reference is a Mention plus Identification. Basis must be a span other than the mention: EDITOR_NOTE, RIJAL_ENTRY, SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT (heading subject, يَعْنِي). No basis = unidentified text, never a node; no namaq-authored basis. Competing sourced identifications all DISPUTED. Reuse via chain-segment identification per work, approved once plus sample. Unreviewed identifications shown as labelled text, never graph edges.

Tradition groups unmerged Statements through Membership with typed basis (EDITOR_NOTE, TAKHRIJ_ENTRY, ATRAF_INDEX, SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT, NAMAQ). NAMAQ basis allowed for history and tafsir, labelled 'grouped by Namaq'; for Prophetic (marfu') statements a span basis is required unless the owner relaxes it. Wordings never merged; diffs computed.

Per-record publication, minted ids. Revision hash = record fields + sha256(render(span)) + witness id for every span reached. Re-anchor with identical rendered text lapses nothing; any change in displayed text or witness lapses exactly the dependent records. Only the owner runs model:publish over a change set (PR), writing per-record revisions; agents never publish.

Authored: data/works/<work>/{work,editions,witnesses}.yaml and units/*.yaml (one per tarjama/hadith/ayah-comment: spans, statements, chains, assertions), data/entities/ (agents, identifications), data/glosses/, sources per edition/witness. Change sets = PRs listing record ids. PG and Neo4j derived. NARRATED_FROM from reviewed identifications only, never across Gap, carries modeKey+span ids, separate isnad view, excluded from centrality. catalog/, batches/ retired; seeds archived. ADR supersedes 0010 layout.

Phase 0 ADRs; 1 text core (spans, render, check) on Siyar v4-5; 2 Siyar conversion with per-statement speaker and review surface; 3 Siyar chains; 4 projection with pre-model tag, dual tables one release, archive, rollback criterion; 5 one Bukhari kitab pilot measuring review minutes as go/no-go for more; 6 tafsir pilot.

Work/Edition/Volume/Witness; Witness per volume range flags vowelled, footnotes, ligature insertion. Shamela only until owner changes it. Bare Sira v1-2 shown with fidelity flag. Edition.numbering map (Bukhari scheme owner-chosen, mapping table); Edition.riwayah chain. Ayah mushaf and qira'a named in ADR; ayah quotations linked, never substituted.

Agents propose; owner reviews and publishes. Prophetic statements (final speaker identified as the Prophet ﷺ): complete chain record with explicit Gaps, no default speaker, no LEGACY, honorifics as printed, two independent reviews (one hadith-trained, recorded with reviewer id). Until a second reviewer exists they remain PROPOSED, text visible, no edges. Review surface before scale; segment-level identification review; pilot measures cost.

Source text never hidden. ADR 0008 kept: unreviewed records shown with status; LEGACY (migration-only) shown as 'no source yet', counted to zero. Our unreviewed judgments (identifications, groupings, classified values) shown as labelled text, never graph edges. For Prophetic statements additionally no LEGACY and no unreviewed grouping/grading label; confirmed in an ADR.

extras.rule_or_trigger: Before public launch, record Shamela's terms in an ADR; until cleared, page text stays in the repo and app as now, no bulk redistribution.
Search indexes a derived diacritic-insensitive form of rendered spans; display always shows the vowelled render.
Quiz questions cite assertion ids; a lapsed or changed assertion unpublishes its questions until re-reviewed.
Reviews record reviewer id and qualification; owner is sole reviewer; Prophetic gate needs a second named hadith-trained reviewer, else stays PROPOSED.
Trigger: hadith pilot. Spot-check sampled pages against printed images; host-inserted ligatures flagged via Witness flag.
Re-fetch or normalisation bump re-resolves all spans; any change in rendered text lapses dependents; Prophetic matn changes require the two-review gate again.
Abbreviations map to full modeKey with span kept; idraj and doubt words are insertion spans with speaker Mention or UNKNOWN.
Trigger: Bukhari pilot. Partial wordings are separate Statements joined by Tradition membership with basis; never reconstructed.
Editor footnotes are Statements with the editor Agent as speaker; takhrij grades are gradings by the editor; sigla are statements of the author.
Shared segments use one ChainSegmentIdentification referenced by all applications; no duplicated identification records.
Trigger: tafsir pilot for qira'at and Bukhari pilot for rijal; owner picks rijal work (Tahdhib al-Kamal) in an ADR before.
Resolve per page in one pass, cached by page hash and normalisation version; projection tests cover disputed edges, Gaps and modeKey.
